sent_to_model:
I need to post a review of Sunbelt Charter Coaches on the vendor board for our Vegas planners group and I need it up tonight. They completely blew the shuttles for my client dinner last Thursday and now they're dodging me on the refund. Half the people in that group use them for airport and offsite runs so they need to know before they book them for CES season. I'm furious but I don't want it to read like a meltdown, people need the actual facts. All the dates and numbers are below.

- Thurs Nov 5, client dinner for 220 ppl, pickup at the hotel at 6:15, offsite at a ranch venue out in Henderson
- booked 4 coaches, confirmed in writing twice, last confirmation Tues Nov 3
- paid $8,400 total, 50% deposit back in Sept, rest 7 days out
- dispatcher name on everything was Corey, office line goes to voicemail since Friday
- only 2 buses showed, first one 55 min late, driver said he got the job at 5pm
- second bus broke down on the 215, AC dead, people stuck on the shoulder ~40 min
- I put 60 ppl in Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, about $1,900
- dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7, caterer charged us overtime
- one late bus I could forgive, no backup plan and no communication is not ok
- they were great on 2 small airport runs last spring which is why I trusted them
- client is now reviewing whether they keep us for their March event, that's on Sunbelt
- refund for the 2 coaches that never came, plus the rideshare costs
- warn other planners, don't book them for anything big until they fix dispatch
- stick to what happened so nobody can say I'm exaggerating

(About me: corporate event planner, 34, Las Vegas, Nevada. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Describes the booked coaches, missing and delayed buses, breakdown and effect on the dinner, explaining the lack of a backup plan and communication during the shuttle failures.
Explains the booking payment and extra rideshare expense.
Requests a refund for the two missing coaches and reimbursement for rideshares.
Warns other planners against large bookings until dispatch is fixed.
Explains the current difficulty reaching the company about the refund.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
